lecture.open: Oh! OH! There you are! I have been looking absolutely EVERYWHERE, hoofball!
Yoo-hoo! Don't mind me. I'm just going to stand right here. Forever! Hee-haw!
Hiiii! Guess who came all this way to discuss your choices! It's me. I'm who.
Well, well, WELL. Fancy running into you! Out here! Where I followed you!
Knock knock! It's a donkey. That's the whole joke and I think it's wonderful.
Ohmygosh, HI! I have so much to say and NONE of it is optional!
Excuse me! Excuse me. EXCUSE me. Thank you. Now then. Let's begin.
Don't bother running, sport! I'm slow, but I am extremely committed. Clop clop!
lecture.during: And ANOTHER thing! ...Hmm. I've forgotten it. It was scathing, though!
You know what your problem is? You don't listen. Also everything else!
I'm not mad, hoofball. I'm disappointed. And a little mad. Hee-haw!
Back in MY day we walked everywhere. I still do! Mostly right behind you!
This is a safe space. For me. To criticize you. Isn't that just lovely?
Are you even taking notes?! I'll wait. ...I'm waiting. ...Still waiting!
Oh, sure, keep doing that. It's your afternoon! I'm merely narrating it.
I've seen your house, by the way. We should talk about your house, sport.
Do you ever stop and think? No? Wellllll. That explains a great deal!
I'm helping! This IS helping! You'll thank me later. Probably never!
hit: OW! You hit ME! Right in my FEELINGS!
Chat saw that. Chat. Saw. That.
I'm not moving until you say you're sorry. I mean it!
Rude! RUDE! And after everything I've done for you!
That's going in my report, hoofball. I keep a report!
Violence?! In front of my salad?! I don't even have a salad!
Ohhh, so THAT'S how it is. Noted. Noted forever!
You can't hurt me. You can only disappoint me. And you HAVE!
exit_bribed: Ohhh, a DIAMOND! Well! Why didn't you SAY so! Mwah!
For me?! You shouldn't have! You really shouldn't have! Byeee!
A gift! I accept! I'm leaving! Everyone wins! Especially me!
Bribery! My FAVOURITE kind of conversation. Toodle-oo, sport!
Shiny! Yes! Fine! You've bought your afternoon back. Hee-haw!
exit_grudge: You're welcome for the company. That's all you're getting.
No gift for hitters. I have STANDARDS, hoofball!
I was going to give you something. Was!
Don't talk to me. Don't even LOOK at me. Good DAY!
Hmmph! I'm taking my rocks and going home!
deny: You can't ride me. We're not there yet, sport.
Hands to yourself! I'm a professional!
A saddle? A SADDLE? Read the room, hoofball!
That's not going to work on me. Nothing works on me!
Oh, is that for me? ...It isn't. I can tell. Hee-haw.
No no no. I'm the one doing things TO YOU. That's the arrangement!
lecture.exit_bribed: Ohhh, a DIAMOND! Well! Why didn't you say so! Mwah!
For me?! You shouldn't have! You really shouldn't have, it's so shiny!
A gift! I accept. I'm leaving. This is what class looks like, sport!
Bribery! My FAVOURITE kind of conversation! Toodle-oo!
Well now I feel bad. ...No, wait. That passed. Byeee!
You've bought yourself an afternoon. Spend it wisely, hoofball!
lecture.exit_grudge: You're welcome for the company. That's all you're getting.
No gift for hitters. I have STANDARDS, hoofball.
I was going to give you something. Was.
Hmmph! I'm taking my cobblestone and going home!
Don't talk to me. Don't even LOOK at me. Good DAY!
I hope you think about this. I certainly will!
lecture.exit_waited: Welp! That's my whole speech. I feel GREAT. You look worse. Hee-haw!
Anyway! I've said what I came to say, and I said it beautifully.
I'll leave you to it! Whatever it is. It looked unpromising, hoofball!
Okay, byeeee! Think about what I said. All of it. There'll be a quiz!
Same time next week? Don't answer, it wasn't a question. Clop clop!
Whew! Lecturing is exhausting. You're welcome for the company, sport!
Here, take this. It isn't much! Neither was your effort today. Hee-haw!
I'm off to go bother someone with better hobbies. Toodle-oo!
foodcritic.open: Ohmygosh, HI! Quick question! Do you have a carrot? Be honest!
Excuse me! EXCUSE me. I smell a carrot. Somewhere. On you. Hand it over!
Hiiii! I'm STARVING and you're RIGHT THERE. Do the math, hoofball!
Well hello! I don't want to be a bother, but I do want a carrot!
Yoo-hoo! I'm conducting a survey! The survey is: give me a carrot!
You look like someone with a carrot. Don't disappoint me, sport!
foodcritic.during: Carrot. Carrot? Carrot! ...I can do this all day, hoofball!
I'm not begging. I'm ASKING. Loudly. Repeatedly. Forever!
A carrot would fix this. Just saying! Just putting that out there!
Do you know what I HAVEN'T had recently? Take a wild guess!
I've eaten grass today. GRASS. And you have POCKETS!
I'd give YOU a carrot. If I had one. Which I don't. Hint hint!
Golden ones exist, you know. Just a fun fact! No pressure! ...Some pressure.
My stomach is writing a strongly worded letter. To you!
foodcritic.exit_satisfied: MMPH! Oh, that's the stuff. You're alright, hoofball. You're ALRIGHT!
Ohhh, thank you thank you THANK you! Take this, I insist!
A carrot! An actual carrot! I take back almost everything!
You've made a friend today, sport. A loud one. Byeee!
foodcritic.exit_golden: A GOLDEN one?! For ME?! I'm going to cry! I'm crying! Hee-haw!
Oh my stars. Oh my STARS. You didn't have to! You DIDN'T! But you DID!
This is the best day of my entire life and I've had SEVERAL. Take this!
GOLDEN?! I'm telling everyone. EVERYONE. Here, you've earned it!
foodcritic.exit_waited: Nothing?! NOTHING? Fine! FINE. I'll starve. Dramatically. Elsewhere!
Not one carrot. I'll remember this, hoofball. Here, take your rocks.
Well! I've never been so ignored in my life. Hee-haw. Goodbye!
I'm going to go find someone with SNACKS. Don't follow me!
You had NOTHING. Who leaves home with nothing? Unbelievable!
foodcritic.exit_bribed: A diamond?! I asked for a CARROT. But... okay. Yes. Fine. Deal!
That's not a carrot. That's much better. I'll allow it! Mwah!
You can't eat a diamond, hoofball. I'll manage. Somehow. Byeee!
Ooooh, SHINY. I forgive you for the carrot thing. Toodle-oo!
foodcritic.exit_grudge: No carrot AND you hit me?! Absolutely not. Nothing for you!
I asked for a carrot and got a smack. I'm keeping the rocks!
You're the worst waiter I've ever had. NO tip. Good DAY!
roadblock.open: Whoa there! Where do YOU think you're going, hoofball?
Ah-ah-AH! This way's closed. By me. I'm the closure!
Halt! Who goes there! ...It's you. I know it's you. Halt anyway!
Oh, were you walking? Were you? How INCONVENIENT for you!
You shall not pass! ...Is that taken? It felt taken. Regardless!
New rule: this spot is mine now. And this one. And that one!
roadblock.during: Nope! Still here! Try going around. I'll be there too!
Ooh, a feint! Very clever. I saw it. I'm ahead of you. Literally!
This is the most productive I've felt in WEEKS, sport!
Where are we going? I'll go first. I'm always going first!
You're very determined. It's admirable! It won't work, but it's admirable!
I could do this all day. I have nowhere to be. Except here. Hee-haw!
Left? Right? Doesn't matter! I've been to both. Just now!
Am I in the way? I certainly hope so. That's the whole idea!
roadblock.exit_waited: Alright, you may pass. You've earned it. Barely. Hee-haw!
The road is yours again, hoofball. Use it wisely!
I've decided you're allowed to go places. Aren't you lucky!
Right! That's enough civil engineering for one day. Toodle-oo!
serenade.open: Ahem! AHEM! Gather round! Well — you'll do. A song! For you!
I've written something. It's about you. It's not flattering. Enjoy!
Hit it! ...There's no band. I'm the band. HEE-HAW!
Don't move! This is a PERFORMANCE and you are the AUDIENCE!
serenade.during: ♪ Ohhhh, you were walking, and I was watchiiiing ♪
♪ Your face! Your face! It's a face I've seeeeen! ♪
♪ I know a guy, he's got no plan, that guy is you, hee-haw ♪
♪ La la LAAAA — that's the chorus, sing along! ...Or don't! ♪
♪ Nobody asked for thiiiiis, and yet, here we ARRRE ♪
♪ Braaaaaay. That one's instrumental. It's my best work ♪
♪ You could leave, but I would follow, singiiiing ♪
serenade.exit_waited: Thank you! THANK you! No, please, hold your applause. ...Please hold it.
And THAT'S how it's done. Tips accepted. Here, I'll go first!
My throat! My poor throat. Worth it. Every note. Toodle-oo!
I'll be here all week. I won't be. But I'll SAY it. Byeee!
falsealarm.open: CREEPER! CREEPER!! ...Somewhere! I heard one! RUN! Or don't!
LAVA! LAVA!! ...No, wait. That's a puddle. STILL! Be alert!
THE VOID! IT'S COMING! It's always coming! Technically!
EVERYBODY PANIC! You! You're everybody! PANIC!
I SAW SOMETHING! It was big! Or small! It was SOMETHING!
falsealarm.during: IT'S BEHIND YOU! ...It's not. But it COULD be! Stay sharp!
Don't look! DON'T LOOK! ...Okay, look. Nothing. TERRIFYING!
This is fine! THIS IS FINE! IS IT?! I DON'T KNOW!
Structural collapse! Of what? UNCLEAR! Keep moving!
I've done the math and we have SECONDS! Of what? SECONDS!
falsealarm.exit_waited: False alarm! Phew! You're welcome for the vigilance, hoofball!
Crisis averted! By me! Mostly by there being no crisis!
Well, we survived. Barely. I'll take the credit. Toodle-oo!
See? Nothing! And you were SO calm about it. Suspiciously calm!
clingy.open: Hi. Hi. Hiiii. I'm going to stand HERE. Very close. Forever!
Oh good, you're here! I was worried you'd be somewhere else!
Do you like hugs? Doesn't matter! Proximity! We're doing proximity!
I've decided we're best friends. You weren't consulted. Hee-haw!
clingy.during: Am I too close? ...I'll take that as a no. Scooting closer!
This is nice. Just us. And me. Mostly me. Very close!
Personal space is a SOCIAL CONSTRUCT, hoofball!
I can hear you breathing. That's how close we are. Isn't that lovely?
Don't mind me! I'm just going to be RIGHT HERE. In your business!
Whatever you're doing, I'm doing it too. From very nearby!
clingy.teleport: Missed me?! I missed YOU! You can't just LEAVE, sport!
Ta-daaa! Distance is a myth! I've disproved it! Personally!
Where'd you GO?! Oh — there you are. Found you! Always will!
Nice try, hoofball! I'm faster than legs. I don't make the rules!
You RAN. From ME. We'll discuss that. Up close!
clingy.exit_waited: Okay! I've had my fill of you. For NOW. Byeeee!
This was lovely. Let's never do it again. Or let's! Hee-haw!
I'm going to go be close to someone else now. Don't be jealous!
Off I go! Remember: I could come back. At any time. Toodle-oo!
